items.work: Appalachian Spring · Rodeo · Billy the Kid — orchestral suites
items.label: Sony Classical
items.note: Bernstein’s New York Philharmonic collection brings together the orchestral suites from all three ballets, including the four dance episodes from Rodeo. The programme includes music for a frontier-town street and a corral at night, and the Shaker tune ‘Simple Gifts’.

links.title: Bernstein Century — Copland ballet suites on Apple Music

items.work: Variations on a Shaker Melody — symphonic-band version
items.performers: United States Army Field Band; Finley R. Hamilton
items.label: Altissimo!
items.note: The Shaker tune ‘Simple Gifts’ appears here in Copland’s scoring for symphonic band, with saxophones and euphonium among the winds. Hamilton’s Army Field Band recording presents the variations from Appalachian Spring as a self-contained piece.
